_comment: 🔮️ This subset's own contribution. The ✳️any sibling registers `image` 0.25 for the DOCUMENT vocabulary; this conformance-class vocabulary registers no oracle, because `image`'s public surface cannot see any of the five T.81 Annex F axes it addresses — see noOracleDecisions for the full reasoning, including why a byte-level differential would be vacuous here even with a perfect one.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: Two independent reasons, and the first is the decisive one. (1) NO CANDIDATE CAN SEE THE AXES. This vocabulary addresses the SOF marker byte, the frame's sample precision, whether a DAC arithmetic-conditioning segment is present, the per-class Huffman table count and each component's sampling factors — every one of them a field of the frame header or the entropy-coding mode. `image` 0.25 is registered by the sibling ✳️any subset and is the right reference for a JPEG raster, but its public API hands back pixels, dimensions and a colour type; it exposes no frame header, no SOFn discriminant, no DAC flag and no DHT view, and it offers no way to WRITE any of them either. `jpeg-decoder` exposes only an `ImageInfo`. A reference that cannot express the mutation cannot adjudicate it, and registering one anyway to satisfy the workflow would be selecting a weak oracle mechanically. (2) EVEN A PERFECT ORACLE WOULD BE MEASURING NOTHING AT THE BYTE LEVEL, because this repository's own `encode_jpg` writes a conforming baseline file and no other kind of JPEG at all: it emits `FF C0` for the frame marker, precision 8, a fixed three-component 4:2:0 sampling array, exactly four DHT segments and never a DAC — so every axis this vocabulary moves is normalized away on re-serialization. That is a real, documented property of the codec (stated in the vocabulary's own module docstring), not a gap. The substitutes are therefore the standard's own tables — ITU-T T.81 Table B.1 for the SOFn marker codes, §4.2 for the 8-bit precision mandate, Annex F for Huffman-only entropy coding, §B.2.4.2 for the four-table-per-class ceiling and §B.2.2 for the 1..=4 sampling factors — read against `check_baseline_conformance`, which is where the class verdict actually lives; plus the inverse law as a metamorphic property over the decoded snapshot. `mutate-jpg-jfif-1-01-baseline` measures the vocabulary there and says in as many words that it makes no byte-level claim, except in `identity-round-trip`, which does re-encode and reads both sides through the INDEPENDENT `image` reader the ✳️any subset registers. [Narrowed 2026-09-02, ticket 26/09/02/SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION shard D2: capabilities emptied because a real mutationManifest now requires a qualifying third-party oracle for this exact capability, and noOracleMisuseBreaches correctly refuses to let a recorded decision paper over a real runtime requirement (per shard A10's precedent for mathematical/sequence/draw) -- the honest state is a visible missing-external-oracle gap, not a hidden one. Rationale above is kept for the record: it still explains why no third-party library is credible for this domain, which is exactly why the gap is expected to stay open rather than be filled.]
